title: Invoice date (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 1 demos. Calendar dimensions/holidays; economic observations by explicitly selected date role.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core date; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Separate calendar date, local wall time, UTC instant, duration, observation period and validity bounds. Timezone, calendar and source event role are prerequisites for conversion. Employees 9999-01-01 is an open-ended validity sentinel; shift time lacks a date. A midnight string alone does not establish a UTC instant. Date-only native/source semantics can reuse core date; timestamp truncation needs an explicit query transformation.
